evidence.quote: Purple star-shaped flowers (measuring 1.5 to 3cm across) appear in summer (October - January), followed by distinctive four-lobed fruits... Fruits turns shiny reddish-brown to light purple when ripe (January - May) and may remain on the tree for long periods.

harvestMonths.notes: Flowering Oct-Jan (months [10,11,12,1] for reference only, not the harvested product); fruit ripens Jan-May and 'may remain on the tree for long periods' per the same source, so the ripening window is wide/soft rather than a sharp harvest peak.

chillUnits.notes: Deciduous to semi-deciduous shrub/small tree, frost-hardy per PZA; no source states a chilling requirement or its explicit absence.

pollination.notes: PZA notes the flowers 'feeds honeybees' (nectar/insect visitation) but makes no explicit self-fertile / needs-cross-pollinator / dioecious statement, so left null rather than inferring from bee visitation alone.
